payload.description:
As a dispatcher I want both Antigravity tanks (Gemini vs Claude/GPT) with 5h and weekly windows so emptying one tank is not treated as emptying the product.

Feature: Antigravity leftover
  Scenario: one tank empty is not both empty
    Given Antigravity leftover with Gemini remaining and Claude-GPT exhausted
    When Spotticus scores Antigravity pools
    Then Gemini remains an eligible tank
    And Claude-GPT is not eligible
payload.title: Antigravity leftover treats Gemini and Claude-GPT as separate tanks
